source.title: Survival and maturation of human induced pluripotent stem cell-derived dopaminergic progenitors in the parkinsonian rat brain is enhanced by transplantation in a neurotrophin-enriched hydrogel

material: Neurotrophin-enriched (GDNF+BDNF) collagen type 1 hydrogel crosslinked with four-arm StarPEG

formulation.evidence: the hydrogel was composed of 5 mg ml−1 type 1 collagen crosslinked with 4 mg ml−1 four arm-StarPEG
the hydrogel was composed of 5 mg ml−1 type 1 collagen crosslinked with 4 mg ml−1 four arm-StarPEG
the neurotrophins, GDNF and BDNF, were included in the transplant (500 ng & 1000 ng per rat, respectively
the neurotrophins, GDNF and BDNF, were included in the transplant (500 ng & 1000 ng per rat, respectively

processing.evidence: the striatum was infused with 300 000 iPSC-DAPs at day 16 of differentiation (6 µl transplants
the striatum was infused with 300 000 iPSC-DAPs at day 16 of differentiation (6 µl transplants

biology.species: human cells in athymic nude rat

other_outcomes.evidence: the neurotrophin-enriched hydrogel enhanced STEM121 immunopositive graft volume by 12.9 fold and HuNu immunopositive nuclei by 8.2 fold
other_outcomes.name: fold increase in HuNu immunopositive nuclei vs cells alone

other_outcomes.evidence: the neurotrophin-enriched hydrogel enhanced STEM121 immunopositive graft volume by 12.9 fold
other_outcomes.name: fold increase in STEM121 graft volume vs cells alone

other_outcomes.evidence: the neurotrophin-enriched hydro￾gel enhanced TH immunopositive graft volume by 12.5 fold and TH immunopositive cell counts by 16.2 fold
other_outcomes.name: fold increase in TH immunopositive graft volume vs cells alone

other_outcomes.evidence: the neurotrophin-enriched hydro￾gel enhanced TH immunopositive graft volume by 12.5 fold and TH immunopositive cell counts by 16.2 fold
other_outcomes.name: fold increase in TH immunopositive cell counts vs cells alone

other_outcomes.evidence: 11.2 ± 1.9% of surviving cells matured when they were transplanted in the neurotrophin￾enriched hydrogel
other_outcomes.name: percentage of surviving cells differentiated into TH+ dopaminergic neurons

other_outcomes.evidence: 7/7 rats in the ‘Cells & Hydrogel & Neurotrophins’ group had maturation of >5%
other_outcomes.name: rats with dopaminergic maturation >5%

notes: Injected intra-striatally into 6-OHDA lesioned female athymic nude rats; survival assessed by HuNu/STEM121, maturation by TH at 20 weeks. Early timepoints (days 1,4,7) showed larger grafts in hydrogel groups. Unloaded hydrogel group also tested but no specific values stated in text.
